headline: On November 5, 2013: India launches Mars Orbiter Mission
captionCards: First Asian nation to reach Mars orbit
Only national agency to succeed with indigenous propulsion on first try
instagramCaption:
India's first interplanetary probe blasts off.

The Mars Orbiter Mission, or Mangalyaan, launched on November 5, 2013, from Sriharikota. It was India’s first mission to another planet and made ISRO the fourth space agency to reach Mars orbit. The probe achieved orbit around Mars on September 24, 2014, using an indigenously developed propulsion system. This made India the first Asian nation to successfully orbit Mars.

It remains a landmark in low-cost space exploration and national technological achievement.
